exposure: uterine isthmic tourniquet left in situ
outcome: postoperative additional interventions (relaparotomy hysterectomy, balloon tamponade application, uterine or vaginal packing)
cohort: Patients who underwent surgery for placenta previa-accreta spectrum disorders at a tertiary hospital between 2017 and 2024.
finding: The uterine isthmic tourniquet left in situ technique was 100% effective in preventing postpartum hemorrhage and preserving the uterus, proving superior to bilateral uterine artery ligation (75% effective) for placenta previa accreta surgery.
